scope: Independent UX/accessibility review of user-authorized chat-first pivot; source-bound approval only, no milestone acceptance.

independentTests.observed: 7 substantive Qt cases; totals9 including init/cleanup, 0 failed/skipped. Real native fixture worker; actual Qt accessibility events/interface assertions.

findings.finding: Failed-message retry could expose another conversation's text.
findings.fix: Retry now derives exclusively from the selected conversation's final failed user message; failed A/new B/return A executable test passes.

findings.finding: Changing status was not fully exposed through accessibility properties.
findings.fix: Actual current status is accessible Name and Description and emits real Qt Alert events; actual platform accessibility handler and interface assertions pass.

findings.finding: Switching conversations cancelled requests without nearby disclosure.
findings.fix: New/list tooltips and accessible description plus active-request status disclose cancellation.

findings.finding: Typing during pending session-control ACK could assign drafts to the wrong chat.
findings.fix: Composer becomes read-only during control ACK and remains editable during model request; executable per-chat draft fence test passes.
Visible message-size feedback appears with accessibility alert; executable limit test passes.

observations: Independent conversation screenshot inspected: dominant transcript and bottom composer; visible session-history and fixture disclosure; markup displayed as inert plain text.
Enter/Shift+Enter, Settings cancel/focus, contextual followup, cancellation/session switching, selected-chat retry, control-ACK draft fencing and oversize feedback independently passed.
Existing validated component workspace remains separate secondary Settings Tools launcher / --tools; chat text cannot launch components or acquire runtime authority.
Current source inventory verified byte-for-byte against frozen Git commit.
limitations: Offscreen Qt checks are not human screen-reader certification.
Chat history is session-only and replies arrive whole; these limits are explicitly disclosed.
No independent live request was made and no real-provider latency/usage/PID claimed. Hosted CI and milestone acceptance remain separate gates; status remains Proposed.
